sloka: राज्ञस्तूपरते वाक्ये जनघोषो महानभूत् ।शनैस्तस्मिन् प्रशान्ते च जनघोषे जनाधिपः ॥२-३-५॥
transliteration: rājñastūparate vākye janaghoṣo mahānabhūt ।śanaistasmin praśānte ca janaghoṣe janādhipaḥ ॥2-3-5॥

translations.english: With the tumult gradually calmed down, the lord of the people, the king (Dasaratha) spoke this to Vasistha, a tiger among ascetics:
